## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-06-29 — do not edit manually*

### Large Files
*~18,000 tokens/session saved*
- `components/route-page-supabase-client.tsx` (~67KB / 2000+ lines) is the main route page component, repeatedly read in full across sessions — `grep -n` for the target selector/identifier first to get line numbers, then `Read` with `offset`/`limit` on that range instead of reading the whole file.
- `app/home-page-client.tsx` (~65KB) and `app/globals.css` (~4000+ lines) are similarly large — same grep-first-then-targeted-read approach applies.

### Dev Preview Server
*~4,000 tokens/session saved*
- Dev server (`npm run dev`) often stays running on port 3000 from a prior session; `preview_start` fails with "Port 3000 is in use" — run `lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9` before calling `preview_start`.
- `.claude/launch.json` configures the preview MCP launch command: `{"name": "grand-transfer-dev"}`.
- Immediately after `preview_resize`, `preview_eval` frequently fails with "Inspected target navigated or closed" — retry the eval once rather than treating it as fatal.

### Vehicle Images
*~1,500 tokens/session saved*
- Car class images live in `img/`: `comfort.png`, `business.png`, `premium.png`, `minivan.png`, referenced from `components/route-page-supabase-client.tsx` (search for `comfortCarImage`/`businessCarImage`/etc. import names, not literal filenames).
